notes.balloon_pop_desc: Verb must match the binding chunk 02 game name 'Pecahkan Balon' (not 'Letuskan'); 'pecahkan angka' alone reads as 'solve the number', so the balloon is named.
notes.game_cat_builders: 'Rakit Angka' is ambiguous as a bare header ('rakit' = raft); 'Susun Angka' is the natural kids' word and matches place_value_desc 'Susun angka dari kepingan!'.
